note: P7 prepares calibrated predictors shared by myopic and DRL. Do not train DQN here. After calibration, the calibrated myopic is the P8 reference (not provisional P6).

action_conditional_risk.note: Never filled with policy-level harmful_flip or case harm costs.

sequential_experience.note: action_level_harm_cost stays NaN; policy costs are not broadcast onto decisions.

checks.data_partitioning: Keep training and validation scenario seeds strictly separated. Fit normalization and calibration using training data only.
checks.action_coverage: Verify coverage of Classes II and III, different helpers, successful and unsuccessful offloads, and local execution.
checks.safety_labels: Distinguish action-level conditional risk labels from policy-level safety costs. Do not assign aggregate policy harm to individual actions.

partition_rule: Split by independent scenario seed, never by row shuffle within a seed.
deficiency_gate: buildP7Datasets writes deficiencies.json; generate missing experience only if needs_additional_experience is true after P6 completes.
